name: thesis_grid_methods
description: Thesis result 1, the grid-method comparison (docs/experiments/thesis.md): the same market, participants, days and learning under four ways the grid reaches the fees. no_fees: fees recorded, not paid (the reference). powerflow: line loading and voltage drop measured in the AC power flow (the scenario's own settings). graph: [P1]'s graph model, capacity split by inverse line length, voltage drop f_volt * d_ij (eq. 8f). graph_ratings: the graph model with each line's rating. The power flow is recorded in every arm, so the physical outcome is compared on the same footing. OPEN before the final run: the fee points M-28, M-31, M-32, M-33, M-34, M-41; the transformer in the fees; a stress setting for the line ratings (both not built yet); paradigm, budget and seeds after the RL stage.
